name: thtc-store-tests
description: Emulator-backed tests (security rules, order transactions, mail queue, callable auth). Run: npm --prefix tests test

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:callable
scripts.test:core: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-thtc-store --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules.test.js service.test.js"
